en.title: dr
en.summary: This is the letter L337 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: Sound of dr
paragraphs: The letters dr make the sound /dr/. You hear this sound in the word (drum) /drʌm/, which means drum. These two letters together have only one sound in English.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue behind your top front teeth. Release the air while pulling your tongue back into your mouth. Slightly round your lips as you do this. Your vocal cords vibrate for the whole sound. Place a hand on your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Spelling patterns
paragraphs: The letters dr always make the sound /dr/. You find this cluster at the beginning of words like (drop) /drɒp/ and (dress) /drɛs/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add a vowel between the two letters. Blend the two sounds smoothly together. Do not roll your tongue tip. Pull your tongue back without tapping the roof of your mouth.
